findings.location: Introduction, paragraph beginning The geometric part develops two finite constructions
findings.finding: The edited paragraph claims reconstruction of a nonnegative Hamiltonian from a positive transfer matrix. The theorem requires a positive definite contraction. Mere positivity permits a singular matrix without a finite full-space logarithm, or a matrix with an eigenvalue greater than one whose negative logarithm has a negative eigenvalue.
findings.requested_change: Write A strictly positive contraction gives a reflection positive Hankel kernel, and its logarithm reconstructs a nonnegative Hamiltonian.
findings.source_context: Theorem strong:thm:transfer_logarithm explicitly assumes positive definite, self adjoint, and contractive.
